summary.text: Bryan Mouber is the Democratic candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 28, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Alex Bergman.
An attorney, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has practiced law in Kansas for more than 25 years.

paragraphs.text: Bryan Mouber graduated from Shawnee Mission East High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Georgetown University in 1993, and received a law degree from the University of Missouri, Kansas City in 1999, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked as a financial analyst at Boatmen's Bank before law school and later taught commercial law at UMKC's Bloch School of Management for six years and served as a FINRA arbitrator.
Mouber listed properly funding schools, including special and gifted education, building a strong and healthy community, and fair tax policy with sensible regulation as his key messages.
